advice_items.quote: I never finished school... it was in me like this fire to prove people wrong that without having a degree you can still do a lot of things
advice_items.summary_en: Use the drive to prove doubters wrong and don't let a lack of formal education limit your ambition.
advice_items.summary_zh: 学历不代表上限，用证明自己的斗志打破限制

advice_items.quote: always have full control over the money... know where it's going know where it's coming from
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain strict control over your business finances and track every dollar coming in and going out.
advice_items.summary_zh: 时刻掌控企业每一笔现金流的去向与来源

advice_items.quote: every rejection we get is a lesson for the yes we're going to have
advice_items.summary_en: Treat every rejection in sales as a learning lesson that brings you closer to the next yes.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把每一次被拒绝都当成通往成交的必经课程

advice_items.quote: you got to ask a lot of yes questions not a lot of no questions... amateur tell Pros ask
advice_items.summary_en: Top salespeople ask strategic questions that elicit 'yes' responses rather than lecturing the prospect.
advice_items.summary_zh: 顶尖销售靠多提“是”类问题引导成交

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: my mindset was no okay you know what I have to save save save invest and once we reach a certain threshold then we can get something to reward ourselves
advice_items.summary_en: Cut out unnecessary subscriptions and lifestyle expenses early on to aggressively save and invest first.
advice_items.summary_zh: 初期砍掉非必要订阅消费，先储蓄再投资

advice_items.quote: if you have an idea execute on that idea whatever idea that is no matter what people tell you
advice_items.summary_en: Execute immediately on your business idea regardless of what skeptics say.
advice_items.summary_zh: 有商业想法就立刻去执行，不要光想不做

advice_items.quote: when you bring that idea to someone who actually has a business they will tell you bro go for that business... it depends on who you get your advice from
advice_items.summary_en: Seek business advice only from people who actually run businesses, not from outsiders who fear risk.
advice_items.summary_zh: 只向真正做成事业的实战派请教，远离外行劝退

guests.first_money_or_break: 曾穷到卖婚戒付1300美元房租，未完成学业，从挨家挨户做销售起步，后投身金融行业创业，8年内做到1200万美元年营收。
guests.zero_start_advice: 有想法就立刻去执行，不要听信不懂商业的人的质疑；初期砍掉所有不必要订阅消费，拼命存钱并持续投资，同时牢牢掌控公司资金流向。

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: focus on being at the right place and at the right time... I also mean the industry... either I would choose AI or I would choose blockchain or web three
advice_items.summary_en: Position yourself in the right industry at the right time, such as AI or blockchain/Web3 today.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选对时代风口行业，当前聚焦AI与Web3

advice_items.quote: when you come from nothing you can only go up you cannot go down the sky is the limit
advice_items.summary_en: Coming from nothing is an advantage because you have nothing to lose and can only go up.
advice_items.summary_zh: 一无所有是最大优势，没有退路只能向上突破

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: it's actually good to be broke when you're starting up because you realize the importance of money even when you make a lot of money you don't spend that much money
advice_items.summary_en: Starting broke teaches you the value of money so you avoid overspending even after becoming wealthy.
advice_items.summary_zh: 经历过贫穷更懂金钱价值，富了也保持节制

advice_items.quote: they want you to invest in fixed deposit but you shouldn't... Banks make money on your money... when you invest it's your own money turning into double triple four times
advice_items.summary_en: Don't park money in low-yield bank fixed deposits where banks profit off your capital; invest directly for growth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别把钱存银行吃死利息，应投资高增长资产

advice_items.quote: I love crypto because it's liquid real estate is not liquid... if you own $15 million in crypto one minute you have your money out
advice_items.summary_en: Favor liquid assets like crypto over illiquid real estate so you can exit positions rapidly when needed.
advice_items.summary_zh: 相比不动产，更应重视加密资产的高流动性

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身印度德里普通家庭，16岁开始创业，2021年4月创立区块链公司，在11个月内融资超1亿美元、估值达15亿美元。
guests.zero_start_advice: 选择处于正确风口的行业（当前看好AI与区块链/Web3），从一无所有起步反而没有包袱且更懂金钱价值，不要把钱存在银行定期，而是投资高增长且高流动性的资产。

advice_items.quote: make friends be a non-transactional person... start humanizing the relationships first and then once you create a human to human relationship with the wealthiest people they'll take you everywhere
advice_items.summary_en: Approach wealthy and successful people non-transactionally to build genuine human friendships before talking business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先交朋友不谈生意，以非功利真心建立人脉

advice_items.quote: the worst ideas executed well are going to outperform the best ideas executed poorly
advice_items.summary_en: Strong execution always outperforms great ideas that are poorly executed.
advice_items.summary_zh: 执行力永远胜过好点子，烂点子做好也能大卖

advice_items.quote: life is too damn short to be shy... you want to make it and you want to make it big run your mouth... a closed mouth does not get fed
advice_items.summary_en: Overcome introversion and shyness, speak up, and actively pitch yourself and your ideas to win big opportunities.
advice_items.summary_zh: 绝不要害羞，多开口推销才能抓住商业机会

advice_items.quote: if we can get enough people with the right mindset to just take a moment to talk to each other over a coffee... you got to create these Collision hours for yourself
advice_items.summary_en: Don't wait for lucky encounters—proactively host coffees and gatherings to create serendipitous 'collision hours' with driven people.
advice_items.summary_zh: 主动组织聚会制造碰撞时刻，创造合作契机

advice_items.quote: tech has infinite scale when you're building software you don't need to produce a physical good... it then becomes all about investing in your go to market strategy
advice_items.summary_en: Build digital products with infinite scalability rather than physical goods, and invest heavily in your go-to-market distribution.
advice_items.summary_zh: 做能无限复制的数字科技产品，用营销放大规模

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: think about the problem that needs to be solved in 5 years from now and invest in it from right now... don't follow Trends... invest in deep Tech... future of AI and automation
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid chasing current trends and instead build deep-tech solutions in AI, automation, and supporting infrastructure for problems 5 years ahead.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别追逐现有热点，提前五年布局AI与深科技

advice_items.quote: mortgage Tech I know it sounds boring but boring businesses are really really great businesses to invest in
advice_items.summary_en: Boring businesses like mortgage tech are often among the most profitable and reliable investments.
advice_items.summary_zh: 枯燥但刚需的传统垂直行业往往最赚钱

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Build Companies With an Exit in Mind
advice_items.quote: investments in the AI space right now that are both going to get Acquired and so they were purposely built to be acquired
advice_items.summary_en: Consider building specialized tech startups purposefully designed to solve a strategic need and get acquired by major players.
advice_items.summary_zh: 从创立起就以被大厂收购为目标来打造项目

guests.first_money_or_break: 计算机专业出身，早年做程序员并曾多次破产，在科技与风投领域深耕创业17年，单年最高收入超5000万美元。
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要害羞，走出屏幕主动社交并制造“碰撞时刻”，以非功利交友的方式结交高端人脉；同时选择可无限复制的数字/科技产品，盯着5年后的未来趋势提前布局。

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Concentrate to Build Wealth, Diversify to Keep It
advice_items.quote: first you have to make it you go all in on your idea because you don't have money but when you have money you have to be Diversified
advice_items.summary_en: Go all in on one idea while building your initial fortune, then diversify to stay balanced once you have wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 没钱时孤注一掷死磕，致富后必须分散配置

advice_items.quote: if everyone wants to leave I go there and work overnight right you just don't give up you just keep going
advice_items.summary_en: Outwork everyone, stay late overnight when needed, and refuse to give up.
advice_items.summary_zh: 团队下班后依然通宵死磕，绝不轻言放弃

advice_items.quote: if you lose money on certain things you don't give up you take the knowledge that you got from that experience and you go and create other stuff
advice_items.summary_en: When a venture fails, take the hard-earned knowledge from that loss and apply it to build your next project.
advice_items.summary_zh: 失败亏钱不可怕，把踩坑经验转化为新项目

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Allocate Core Capital to Leading Crypto Assets
advice_items.quote: bitcoin's the god of blockchain right... where you put most of your money in and then you put some in the other ones... buy sol... salana blockchain
advice_items.summary_en: Anchor crypto exposure in Bitcoin as the foundational asset while allocating a portion to fast, scalable Layer-1 networks like Solana.
advice_items.summary_zh: 核心资金配置比特币，同时布局高扩展公链

advice_items.quote: you cannot be complacent and you have to keep developing and you have to get the best people to work with you Henry Ford said only with a team you can make it... it's all about talent
advice_items.summary_en: Never get complacent; recruit top talent and build a great team because you cannot succeed alone.
advice_items.summary_zh: 拒绝自满，聚拢顶尖人才与技术团队做大事业

advice_items.quote: trust yourself just go for it yourself do things you love and then if it becomes a business you're going to be very happy
advice_items.summary_en: Trust yourself and pursue things you genuinely love so that building a business brings fulfillment.
advice_items.summary_zh: 相信自己并投身热爱之事，把热爱做成事业

advice_items.quote: key is to invest invest invest don't save but invest invest in yourself in your health in your head and in the businesses... just invest all your life
advice_items.summary_en: Don't just hoard cash—invest continuously throughout your life in your health, mind, businesses, equities, and crypto.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别只顾存钱，要终身投资健康、大脑与资产

guests.first_money_or_break: 出生在苏联时期的立陶宛（成长于澳大利亚），白手起家；2000年互联网泡沫破灭时曾倾家荡产，随后凭借对谷歌排名的理解创办全球第一扑克网站PokerNews.com翻身，现经营区块链公司年入1亿美元、净资产3亿美元。
guests.zero_start_advice: 没钱时要孤注一掷拼命干并组建顶尖团队，失败了也不要放弃而是把经验用到下一个项目；有钱后要做好多元化配置，不要只存钱，要持续投资自己的健康、大脑、事业以及股票和区块链资产。
